## Read data

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
# library(monocle3)
library(ggprism)
# library(fgsea)
library(future)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 16 * 1024^3)  # 16 GB
library(qs2)
```

```{r load_data}

snrna.data <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors_raw.rds"))
```

```{r cca_integration}

split_snrna <- snrna.data
split_snrna[["RNA"]] <- split(split_snrna[["RNA"]], f = split_snrna$orig.ident)

split_snrna[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(split_snrna, pattern = "^MT-")
split_snrna <- subset(split_snrna, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & nCount_RNA < 40000 & percent.mt < 15)
split_snrna <- NormalizeData(split_snrna, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
split_snrna <- FindVariableFeatures(split_snrna, selection.method = "vst")
split_snrna <- ScaleData(split_snrna, verbose = FALSE)

split_snrna <- RunPCA(split_snrna, seed.use = 2026, verbose = FALSE)

split_snrna <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = split_snrna,
  method = CCAIntegration,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
  new.reduction = "integrated.cca"
)

```

```{r umap}
split_snrna <- RunUMAP(split_snrna, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "cca.umap", return.model = TRUE)
split_snrna <- FindNeighbors(split_snrna, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30)
split_snrna <- FindClusters(split_snrna, cluster.name	= "cca_clusters", resolution = 2, random.seed = 2026, algorithm = 4)

id_cca_plot <- DimPlot(split_snrna, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "cca.umap") + ggtitle("Sample ID")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/id_cca_plot.png"), id_cca_plot, height = 7, width = 8, units = "in")

clus_cca_plot <- DimPlot(split_snrna, group.by = "cca_clusters", reduction = "cca.umap", label = TRUE) + NoLegend() + ggtitle("CCA clusters res 2")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/clus_cca_plot.png"), clus_cca_plot, height = 7, width = 8, units = "in")

id_cca_plot_split <- DimPlot(split_snrna, split.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "cca.umap", ncol = 3, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/id_cca_plot_split.png"), id_cca_plot_split, height = 18, width = 18, units = "in")

mut_cca_plot_split <- DimPlot(split_snrna, split.by = "Tumor_Type", reduction = "cca.umap", ncol = 3, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/mut_cca_plot_split.png"), mut_cca_plot_split, height = 7, width = 14, units = "in")

source("~/Projects/etmr/defaria/scripts/functions.R")

cca_umapdf <- split_snrna@meta.data |>
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, cca_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell")

hist_cca_id <- plot_hist(cca_umapdf, "cca_clusters", "orig.ident") + labs(title = "Sample ID", fill = "Sample ID")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/hist_cca_id.png"), hist_cca_id, height = 7, width = 8, units = "in")

hist_cca_mut <- plot_hist(cca_umapdf, "cca_clusters", "Tumor_Type") + labs(title = "Mutation", fill = "Mutation")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/hist_cca_mut.png"), hist_cca_mut, height = 7, width = 8, units = "in")

```

### Score cell types

```{r annotation, warning=FALSE}
for (x in names(cellmarkers)) {
  split_snrna <- AddModuleScore(
    split_snrna,
    features = cellmarkers[x],
    name = x
  )
}

cca_feat_origcol <- FeaturePlot(split_snrna, 
                            features = paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1"), ncol = 3, 
                            reduction = "cca.umap", 
                            keep.scale = "all", 
                            order = TRUE,
  pt.size = .2) & scale_color_gradient2(
  low = "blue",     # negative values
  mid = "lightyellow",     # zero
  high = "red",     # positive values
  midpoint = 0
) 

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/feat_orig_scale.png"), cca_feat_origcol,height = 22, width = 20, units = "in")

cca_type_long <- split_snrna@meta.data  |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    orig.ident, 
    cca_clusters, 
    paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1")
    ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(cell, 
              orig.ident, 
              cca_clusters), names_to = "cell_type"
    )
  
violin_cca <- cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% c(paste0(names(cellmarkers), "1"))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type, cca_clusters) |>
  dplyr::filter(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 & median(value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() +
  facet_wrap(vars(cell_type), scales = "free")


ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/cca/violin.png"), violin_cca,height = 16, width = 24, units = "in")

cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "NEC (Sol)1") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() 

cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Astrocytes1" & cca_clusters %in% c("26","29")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() 

cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Oligodendrocytes1" & cca_clusters %in% c("26","29")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() 

cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "PC1" & cca_clusters %in% c("31","33")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() 

cca_type_long |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "EC1" & cca_clusters %in% c("31","33")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cca_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() 

cca_type_long |>
```

### Integrate with mouse

```{r load_mouse}

wt_mouse <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/mouse/so_12_SP_WT_prefiltered.rds"))
ko_mouse <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/mouse/so_12_SP_KO_prefiltered.rds"))

merged_mouse <- merge(wt_mouse, ko_mouse, add.cell.ids = c("WT", "KO"))

#join layers to split everything later
merged_mouse <- JoinLayers(merged_mouse)

orthologs <- read.table("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/mouse/orthologs_final_human_mouse.tsv", header = FALSE, col.names = c("human", "mouse", "remove1", "remove2"))[,-c(3, 4)]

genes <- rownames(merged_mouse)

# Match to mapping table
new_names <- orthologs$human[
  match(genes, orthologs$mouse)
]
new_names <- new_names[!is.na(new_names)]

merged_mouse <- merged_mouse[genes[genes%in%orthologs$mouse]]

rownames(merged_mouse) <- new_names

genes_in_common <- intersect(rownames(snrna.data), rownames(merged_mouse))

tumor_to_merge <- snrna.data[genes_in_common]
```

```{r integrate}


qs_to_rds(input_file = "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/mouse/merged_data_filt.qs2", output_file = "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/mouse/merged_data_filt.rds")

  x
})

  x <- ScaleData(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
  x
})

  GetAssayData(x, layer = "data")[features, ]
})

mat_list <- lapply(mat_list, function(m) m[features, ])

library(batchelor)

mnn <- fastMNN(mat_list)

mnn_embedding <- reducedDim(mnn, "corrected")



combined <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = do.call(cbind, mat_list))
mnn_embedding <- as.matrix(reducedDim(mnn, "corrected"))

# ensure alignment
mnn_embedding <- mnn_embedding[colnames(combined), ]

combined[["mnn"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = mnn_embedding,
  key = "MNN_"
)

combined <- RunUMAP(combined, reduction = "mnn", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "mnn.umap", return.model = TRUE)
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, reduction = "mnn", dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, cluster.name	= "mnn_clusters", resolution = 1, random.seed = 2026, algorithm = 4)


DimPlot(combined, reduction = "mnn.umap", group.by = c("orig.ident", "mnn_clusters"))
```

### Integrate with RPCA

```{r best_so_far}

merged_data <- readRDS("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/mouse/merged_data.rds")

merged_data <- lapply(merged_data, function(x) {
  counts <- GetAssayData(x, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
})


merged_data <- lapply(merged_data, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x)
  x
})

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = merged_data, nfeatures = 3000)


merged_data <- setNames(lapply(names(merged_data), function(x) {
  merged_data[[x]]@meta.data$orig.ident <- x
  merged_data[[x]] <- subset(merged_data[[x]], features = features)
  merged_data[[x]]
  }),
  names(merged_data)
)


merged_data <- merge(
  x = merged_data[[1]],
  y = merged_data[-1]
)



merged_data <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_data)
merged_data <- ScaleData(merged_data)

#RunPCA returns the object already, so there's no need to do {} x
merged_data <- RunPCA(merged_data, seed.use = 2026, verbose = FALSE)

#This was filtered to keep genes in common with all the objects, so get back the full object just in case

features <- VariableFeatures(merged_data)

VariableFeaturePlot(merged_data)

#Integrate all the data by id using RPCA, which should be faster than CCA
rpca_data <- IntegrateLayers(
  merged_data,
  features = features,
  method = RPCAIntegration
)

#Run UMAP
rpca_data <- RunUMAP(rpca_data, reduction = "integrated.dr", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "rpca.umap", return.model = TRUE)

rpca_data <- FindNeighbors(rpca_data, reduction = "integrated.dr", dims = 1:30)

#Setting res at 0.8
rpca_data <- FindClusters(rpca_data, cluster.name	= "rpca_clusters", resolution = 0.8, random.seed = 2026, algorithm = 4)


rpca_clus_plot <- DimPlot(rpca_data, reduction = "rpca.umap", group.by = "rpca_clusters", label = TRUE)

rpca_id_plot <- DimPlot(rpca_data, reduction = "rpca.umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

rpca_id_plot_sep <- DimPlot(rpca_data, reduction = "rpca.umap", group.by = "rpca_clusters", split.by = "orig.ident", ncol = 3)

rpca_plot <- rpca_clus_plot + rpca_id_plot

rpca_data@meta.data["species"] <- sub("\\..*$", "", rpca_data@meta.data$orig.ident)

condition_sample <- c("human.GSM8058157"= "tumor", 
  "human.GSM8058158"= "tumor", 
  "human.GSM8058159"= "tumor",
  "human.GSM8058160"= "tumor",

  "mouse.12_WT3_SP"= "WT", 
  "mouse.12_KO1_SP"= "KO",  
  "mouse.12_KO2_SP"= "KO",  
  "mouse.12_KO3_SP"= "KO") 

tail(condition_sample[rpca_data@meta.data$orig.ident])
tail(rpca_data@meta.data$orig.ident)
```
